rationale: The tenant says the kitchen extractor fan will not turn on (initial request). The agency asked the landlord how to proceed (004), and the landlord replies that there is a switch to the right of the hob that needs to be on (008); the tenant's 'Thank you!' (007) answers the earlier acknowledgement, not this. Passing the tip to the tenant and asking her to check is right: the agency did exactly that (009, 010) and the tenant confirmed the fan works once she found the button (011). Booking a contractor has no landlord approval and would be a needless call-out; the fault is not yet confirmed fixed, so closing is premature; nothing establishes a tenant charge.
